fact: The Ijwi ry'Ikirundi AI community project holds a Kirundi text and speech dataset of 4,809 sentences (2,996 complete Kirundi-French-English pairs), with a public 1,813-sentence version free under CC BY-NC 4.0 and the full set on request to researchers and partners; last updated 28 September 2026.
title: Ijwi-ry-Ikirundi-AI/Kirundi_Dataset
